thesis: CROX is a clean trend-continuation setup with accelerating fundamentals. A +25% post-earnings gap has held and extended, and the stock trades above its 20-, 50- and 200-day averages. Revenue growth is improving, net income is up sharply, free cash flow is strong, and valuation multiples are low in absolute terms. It is a consumer name outside the tech/semis selloff that defines the risk-off regime. The setup is only moderate: reward/risk is thin, the stock is extended, beta is high and the regime is hostile, so this is a pullback-entry, modest-size long, not a chase.
